scope: Grand Teton National Park, adjoining NPS-managed John D. Rockefeller Jr. Memorial Parkway, and NPS-published Teton Village starts.
policyDecisionsForReview: Use the stated geographic scope rather than the entire geological Teton Range.
Admit technical scores 1 through 5; exclude scores above 5. Physical endurance remains separate from technical risk.
Create a separate profile only when the start, access, named turnaround, return form, or loop versus out-and-back materially changes.
Retain closed routes only with an obvious maintained closure warning.
Use AllTrails for discovery and comparison only; it cannot supply authoritative TrailPack facts.
Keep a custom route builder as future work rather than adding every permutation.

technicalScale.3: Steep maintained trail without hands-on movement.
technicalScale.4: Rough or loose trail with simple routefinding.
technicalScale.5: Intermittent hands-on movement, boulder fields, unmaintained tread, or limited exposure requiring warnings.
technicalScale.6: Sustained scrambling, off-trail travel, consequential routefinding, or meaningful exposure.
